description: Create a signed, pending human-approval request with a 1-tap approval URL (POST /v1/approval/request). Real HMAC-signed record via ctx.memory; message dispatch is honestly labeled as queued/not_attempted.
name: approval_request
provider_notes: Signing key from ctx.auth_get('approval_signing_key'); falls back to an ephemeral per-machine key, honestly labeled 'local_ephemeral'. Channel provider credential '{channel}_send' gates real dispatch (Crew C send_* modules); this module never claims a message was sent. Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
